description:
AutoLang is a multilingual virtual synthesizer for NVDA. It finds the language of the text from its script and reads each part with the synthesizer, voice, rate, pitch, volume and punctuation level that you chose for that language.
AutoLang is made and maintained by Dr. Narayan B Raikar.
It is based on the MultiLang add-on written by Alexander Linkov (Kvark). Original project: https://gitverse.ru/kvark128/MultiLang
